name: ScnUpdateMode
meaning: Argument of an inlined update-mode setter that unoptimised MSVC compiles as a 4-way jump table on a constant (seen at 0x50d89e table 0x50d93b and 0x50a094 table 0x50a1d9). It edits ScnObject.flags (+0x3a).

name: SCN_UPD_NORMAL
meaning: clear 0x4000 and 0x2000: updated only within the 3000-unit camera radius
